prompts.body: Seamless 64x64 golden wheat field terrain tile for a top-down 3/4 RPG tilemap, mature harvest wheat filling the whole tile, no other ground type.
32x32 packed dirt road center tile for a rural RPG tilemap, no grass or wheat edge, usable inside a wider crossroad.
32x32 packed dirt road tile with golden wheat field border along the top edge only, road continues through the rest of the tile.
32x32 packed dirt road tile with golden wheat field border along the bottom edge only, road continues through the rest of the tile.
32x32 packed dirt road tile with golden wheat field border along the left edge only, road continues through the rest of the tile.
32x32 packed dirt road tile with golden wheat field border along the right edge only, road continues through the rest of the tile.
32x32 reddish packed-earth running track center tile, clean track surface, no edge, for composing an oval track on a RPG tilemap.
32x32 top-left curved running track tile, reddish packed-earth curve turning from top segment to left segment, transparent outside curve.
32x32 top-right curved running track tile, reddish packed-earth curve turning from top segment to right segment, transparent outside curve.
32x32 bottom-left curved running track tile, reddish packed-earth curve turning from bottom segment to left segment, transparent outside curve.
32x32 bottom-right curved running track tile, reddish packed-earth curve turning from bottom segment to right segment, transparent outside curve.
Slim scarecrow sprite standing beside a track in a golden wheat field, bamboo pole frame, straw body, old cloth shirt and simple straw hat, clear silhouette for 32px tile RPG map.
